entries.description: The house with a Sakura tree in its garden.
The local produce market with a green-and-white striped awning and fruit crates out front.
The green-shuttered house with a hanging lantern and orange pumpkins lined up on its front porch.
The brown-roofed house with a stone birdbath in the left yard and a blue car parked under the carport.
The white-fenced house with an orange picnic table, chairs, and basket set under the tree.
The white house right at the curve entrance, featuring a dark forest-green roof and shutters.
The twin house estate with two orange trees at the gate, a stone water well, and wooden barrels in the courtyard.
The unfenced forest cottage with a stone path and a tree stump resting under the giant tree.
The cream-colored house with a red bicycle leaning against it.
The black-roofed house with green window frames and bright blue flowers blooming in its front yard.
The light blue-roofed house with a wooden bench and watering can nestled among colorful flowers.
The brown-roofed house with two street lamps standing at the gate and a rock garden.
The house at the curved road corner featuring a curved white picket fence and a red swing set in the yard.
The twin houses connected overhead by a covered wooden bridge with a flowering courtyard.
The white house with a colorful flower meadow, set against wind turbines turning on the hill behind.
The modern house at the cul-de-sac turnaround, surrounded by high stone walls and an iron gate.
